properties.name: deployFolderName
properties.doc: name of the folder models get deployed to, usually the same as last segment of original path

properties.name: extracted
properties.doc: true indicates the root has been extracted automatically and values can get updated during project re-load process

properties.name: convert2binary
properties.doc: true indicates model files have to be piped though a convertor that re-saves them into binary persistence, if possible

nodes.name: resources
nodes.doc: Tells what files to treat as auxiliary module resources (e.g. icons, externalized messages, etc.)

children.doc: I use file set, not SingleFolder as other _ModuleSource concepts do to get behavior similar to that with template-hardcoded icons/*, resources/* pattern
